name: After recital A
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: Aa. whereas country-specific recommendations in the framework of the European Semester tend to incentivise cuts in social services and social protection instead of promoting an increase in public revenues; whereas in the period from the introduction of the European Semester in 2011 up to 2018, the Commission recommended on 63 occasions that governments cut spending on healthcare or privatise health services1a; whereas from 2016 to 2022, the Commission recommended reforms to pension systems 122 times, including 30 calls to increase the retirement age1b; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a [https://www.dielinke-europa.eu/wp-content/uploads/kontext-import/documents/9/3/d70fc8.pdf](https://www.dielinke-europa.eu/wp-content/uploads/kontext-import/documents/9/3/d70fc8.pdf). 1b [https://www.econstor.eu/bitstream/10419/299865/1/1844117693.pdf](https://www.econstor.eu/bitstream/10419/299865/1/1844117693.pdf).
